title: Preserve complete SRD creature statline semantics
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P1/P2 systemic modeling loss.
- All 317 creatures store armorClass and hitPoints as bare ints.
- Quantified losses:
  - 206 AC parentheticals dropped, such as "natural armor" or "leather armor, shield".
  - 316 HP dice formulas dropped, such as "19d12 + 133".
  - 7 hover speed annotations dropped, e.g. "fly 40 ft. (hover)".
  - 4 form-conditional speed lines dropped (Werewolf/Wereboar/Weretiger/Werebear), e.g. "30 ft. (40 ft., climb 30 ft. in bear or hybrid form)".
  - 6 conditional/alternate AC lines flattened: 3 lycanthrope dual-form ACs, Mage "(15 with mage armor)", Druid "(16 with barkskin)", Ankheg "14 (natural armor), 11 while prone".
- Examples:
  - Werewolf/Wereboar/Werebear lose beast-form AC; four lycanthropes lose form speeds.
  - Werebear currently has climb: 30 as a base speed, but source grants climb 30 only in bear/hybrid form, where walk is also 40 rather than 30. This is actively wrong data, not just loss.
  - Mage loses "(15 with mage armor)".
  - Druid loses "(16 with barkskin)".
  - Ankheg loses "11 while prone".
  - Hover/fly conditional data is invisible to deterministic behavior.
- Fable notes stat-block records already model hitPoints as { value, formula } (see stat-block:giant-fly), so there is a precedent; creature parser discards what another parser keeps.

Gameplay impact:
- No HP rolling/max-HP variants.
- Wrong AC for transformed/form-variant creatures.
- AC explanations lose armor/natural armor/spell context.
- Hover/prone/falling semantics unavailable to combat tools.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creature statline data preserves the full printed semantics rather than flattening to ints.
- Compatibility for existing consumers is maintained or migrated deliberately.
- Gates fail when printed AC parentheticals, HP formulas, XP, conditional AC/speeds, or hover semantics are dropped.
close_reason: Epic complete in PR #394: full printed creature statline semantics preserved (structured AC/HP/speed + hover + form variants + verbatim source texts), compatibility migrated deliberately (encounterCombatants accepts both shapes; schema/tests updated), gates fail on any dropped statline semantics. 317 creature records regenerated; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exit 0; full suite green.
